[오늘의 단어]
- long-term: 장기의
- strike up a conversation: 대화를 시작하다
- fall into a slump: 슬럼프에 빠지다
- treat: 대하다, 여기다, 처리하다
- keep at it: 견디어내다, 계속하다
- indirectly: 간접적으로
- recurrence: 되풀이, 반복, 재발
- severe: 극심한, 심각한
- temperament: 기질
- companion: 동반자, 친구
- fascinating: 대단히 흥미로운, 매력적인

[오늘의 문장]
- I set a long-term goal for myself.
- There were times when I fell into a slump.
- I always treated English as a hobby and kept at it.

- I only thought of it as another appliance, but now it feels like a beloved companion.
- It was fascinating to watch them grow so quickly.
